description: Decodes eight gate inputs as an eight-bit number and puts out one voltage for it

params.text: Scales the decoded voltage, -1 to +1, and starts at 0.2 so that a full-scale code gives 1V
Adds an offset of -5V to 5V to the decoded voltage after scaling
Cycles the decoder: Uni. 8 reads a positive value with bit 8 most significant, Bi. Off. centres the value on zero, Bi. Sig. reads bit 8 as the sign and bit 7 as most significant
Cycles rectification of the decoded voltage: None passes it, Half replaces negative voltages with 0V, Full takes the absolute value

inputs.text: One bit of the number being decoded, counted as 1 at 1V or more; bit 1 is worth the least and bit 8 the most
A rising gate here updates the output; with nothing patched it is recalculated every sample
Feeds all eight bits from one polyphonic cable, channel 1 as bit 1; a cable in a numbered jack takes over that bit
